# Grok 模型搜索自由知识图谱

## 模型结构总览 [BV1fHge6HEuo P1 00:24]
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    SearchEngine["Grok 搜索引擎"] --> RealTime["实时联网 & 连接推特"]
    SearchEngine --> TopOne["被视为 Top One 搜索引擎"]
    FreeAccount["免费账户"] --> FastMode["fast (agent)"]
    FastMode --> ModeComp["模式比较"]
    FourA["4 A 进程模型"] --> ModeComp
    SixteenEngines["16 engines (agents) 模型"] --> ModeComp
    ExportHave["export / have (对应 4/16 ENGINT)"] --> FourA
    ExportHave --> SixteenEngines
```

## 部署流程总览 [BV1fHge6HEuo P1 03:23]
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    PurchaseVPS["购买 VPS (99元/年)"] --> PurchaseDomain["购买域名"]
    PurchaseDomain --> SetDNS_CF["在 Cloudflare 设置 DNS"]
    SetDNS_CF --> TransferDomain["域名转移到 Cloudflare"]
    TransferDomain --> DeployCDMail["部署 CD mail 项目"]
    DeployCDMail --> ConfigureAI["AI 配置 GLOCK2API & 注册机"]
    ConfigureAI --> EnableWARP["使用 WARP 洗白流量"]
    EnableWARP --> TestDeployment["测试部署"]
    TestDeployment --> LoginConsole["登录 Console"]
    LoginConsole --> UseModel["使用模型 (fast / 4A / 16)"]
```

## 域名转移到 Cloudflare 流程 [BV1fHge6HEuo P1 05:01]
```mermaid
flowchart LR
    DomainProvider["域名提供商"] --> AddToCart["加入购物车"]
    AddToCart --> Purchase["完成购买"]
    Purchase --> DNSManagement["进入域名管理器"]
    DNSManagement --> ChangeNS["更改 NameServer 为 Cloudflare"]
    ChangeNS --> CloudflareLogin["登录 Cloudflare"]
    CloudflareLogin --> AddDomainCF["在 Cloudflare 添加域名"]
    AddDomainCF --> SetDNSRecords["设置 DNS 记录"]
    SetDNSRecords --> Propagation["DNS 传播生效"]
```

## 使用模式选择决策树 [BV1fHge6HEuo P1 14:01]
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Start["需求评估"] --> NeedSpeed["需要快速响应?"]
    NeedSpeed -->|是| ChooseFast["选择 fast (agent)"]
    NeedSpeed -->|否| NeedDepth["需要深度搜索?"]
    NeedDepth -->|是| ChooseFourA["选择 4 A 进程"]
    NeedDepth -->|否| NeedCheck["需要检查/切割模型?"]
    NeedCheck -->|是| UseCheckModel["使用 check 模型切割"]
    NeedCheck -->|否| ChooseSixteen["选择 16 A 进程 (深度模式)"]
```
